shell.ribbon: Choose the dataset type first, then import and analyze it in its own dedicated workflow.
shell.heroTitle: Import TODO, Activation, Plainte, and Merged files without mixing their workflows
shell.heroDescription: The admin chooses the import context first. TODO files continue through the TODO study pipeline, Activation CSV stays in the activation analytics flow, Plainte CSV goes into the complaint workflow, and Merged files go into the analytics-only pipeline without triggering any case distribution.
shell.panelTitle: Choose the exact workflow the uploaded file belongs to
shell.pipelineNote: `Todos` uses the TODO study pipeline. `Activation` uses the activation analytics endpoint. `Plaintes` uses the complaint import endpoint. `Merged` uses a dedicated analytics-only pipeline — no case distribution, no notifications.

importTypeLabel.activation: Activation CSV import and analytics workspace
importTypeLabel.complaint: Plainte CSV import and complaint workflow workspace
importTypeLabel.merged: Merged Operations analytics — no case distribution
